Let the bar axis be x-axis (horizontal). The load P is in +x direction. The shaded plane is inclined at angle θ to the horizontal. That means the plane itself makes angle θ with the x-axis. The normal to the plane is perpendicular to the plane. If the plane is at angle θ to the x-axis, then the normal is at angle θ to the y-axis (vertical). So the angle between the normal and the x-axis is 90° - θ.

The normal stress on an inclined plane is given by σ_n = σ_x cos²φ, where φ is the angle between the normal to the plane and the x-axis. Here φ = 90° - θ, so cosφ = cos(90° - θ) = sinθ. Then σ_n = σ_x sin²θ = (P/A) sin²θ.
